title: Elements Context Menu Mechanism
description: Unified prop-based contextMenu across @elements/ui, board Node/Edge/Handle, and UIWindowKindDefinition. Radix @radix-ui/react-context-menu, BoardEventMap.contextmenu with hit-test, ContextMenuController on BoardCanvas, vitest and Playwright coverage.
summary: Implemented ContextMenuItem, ContextMenu, ContextMenuController, and renderContextMenuItems using existing @radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu (right-click + invisible anchor; avoids new npm dep blocked by workspace). Extended Card, DiagramNode, UIWindowKindDefinition, and UICanvas portals. Board: BoardEventMap.contextmenu from canvas after pointerMoveScreen hit-test; BoardCanvas builds target menu map from descriptors; contextMenu on Node/Edge/Handle and BoardCanvas background. Board play demos node/edge/window/canvas menus. Vitest: descriptor preservation + contextmenu emission; Playwright: background menu on overview canvas. Ran: npx vitest run in elements/client/lib/board (34 passed).
